name: guide
description: A searchable troubleshooting and how-to knowledge base for Kiro Crew. Look up symptoms and fixes by keyword, platform, or topic — and let any agent query the same guide over MCP so it answers from the official fix instead of guessing.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Keyword-scored search over titles, symptoms, and keywords — filter by platform or topic
Every agent can query the guide over MCP (guide_search / guide_get) and answer from the official fix
Internal editions overlay their own entries on top of the public base with zero code branches
Read-only and self-contained: the search logic behind the UI, the HTTP API, and the MCP tools is one function
useCases: Search Kiro Crew's troubleshooting guide by symptom, platform, or topic, and let agents look up the official fix over MCP.
configuration: Enable the app from the App Store; the public guide entries ship with it, and internal editions add their own via a data overlay.
